summary: The dossiers largely match the verified current facts (record, Finals loss, extensions, City Edition, dates), so few outright errors turned up. Fixed: the Alamodome "first home" error, the Farfisa and Sunglows details, the Southwest School of Art's move to UTSA and the Tobin Center symphony line. Also fixed: a Texas rodeo naming slip, an MLK Day entry implying a Spurs game, inflated "largest Mexican market" claims and two off-palette red hex values. Live checks confirmed the San Marcos Nike Factory Store and Hogwild Records, and corrected the art school. The strategy brief needs an editor on three points. One is the claim that no hand-made West Side vocabulary has reached a Spurs uniform. Another is the Feb 15 Spurs-Heat "road game" premise. The third is unverified player footwear deals. Most local businesses and artists are long-established but unchecked today.
